decisive_items: brown, multilobular lesions confined to the deep corneal stroma
central infiltrate involving all corneal layers and a peripheral infiltrate concentrated in the deep stroma
response.rationale: The presence of brown, multilobular lesions in the deep corneal stroma and the findings on anterior segment optical coherence tomography are consistent with fungal keratitis.

rejected.why: Lack of specific findings related to steroid-induced keratitis
Previous infection had resolved prior to surgery
Immune-mediated response is less likely given the specific findings of fungal keratitis
